nom: BOBBI BROWN Vitamin Enriched Smoothing Serum with Niacinamide + Vitamin C

avis.texte: I love this serum! I mix it with my Bobbi brown vitamin enriched face base at night. It is very moisturizing, and I use it morning and night.

I've used a few Bobbi Brown products, but the one that's impressed me the most is the primer. Because of how much I love it is why I took the step and bought this serum. I thought they'd work well together, and they do. I tend to have skin that reacts to new products, even as my skin matures. There's been absolutely no reactions. I also appreciate that I can rely on a brand, not just the product. I'm really glad I finally made the purchase after thinking about it for several months.

I purchased this along with liquid foundation, primer cream, eye concealer stick, the cream and serum has a lovely scent of citrus. However, the serum to my skin is a bit strong! I'm wondering if it comes in a sensitive skin serum? The primer cream is amazing! however I want the benefits of the serum.
I've used so many different serums and this one is perfect! Highly recommend!

I had tried a sample of this long ago and loved it so I purchased a bottle at the Company Store outlet over the summer when I came across it. It smells awful! The best description is that it smells like playdoh. Because it was purchased at the outlet, it was not returnable. Since it was sooo expensive, I didn't toss it and decided to save it for the really dry weather. Over the last few weeks, I've used it a few times and the smell is really awful and now I'm wondering if it's even safe to use. I don't know if they sell counterfeit products or if this is just how it is.

avis.titre: Great Way to Start the Day
avis.texte: I use this serum in the morning as I have a retinol I like to use in the evening. I have noticed that my skin looks more vibrant - must be the vitamin C in this product. I stock up when this item goes on sale as I do not want to be without it.

This makes my skin feel soooo smooth. I use it with the vitamin enriched face base. After allowing these products to soak into my skin - I apply the Bobbi Brown weightless skin foundation and pressed powder. I am flawless all day!

This product changed the game for me with my skincare routine. I have very sensitive skin due to eczema flare ups and I was worried about this product at first because it does carry a subtle fragrance. But I gave it a chance and thankfully my skin did not react to it. But my skin loved it. It's lightweight, hydrating and makes my skin feel so plumped and bouncy! People always ask if I have on makeup when I don't. If you don't believe me, just watch! Try it for yourself. But I do know everyone's skin is different, so just be mindful of the ingredients and if your skin may or may not like what's inside. 😊

My 88-year-old mother had a severe reaction to this serum—her entire face turned bright red and inflamed within hours, requiring medical attention. She has used skincare her whole life without issues (not EVER) and does not have sensitive skin. After reviewing the ingredients, I was shocked to see known irritants like Limonene, Linalool, Citral, Geraniol, and Grapefruit Peel Oil—fragrance allergens that do not belong in a "smoothing serum." Very disappointed that a brand of this caliber would formulate something so carelessly.

avis.titre: I will give it a try again

It was completely different - in a good way. So I was right about something about the smell was off. A bit over $60 was wated as I passed the return window. Gifted by Bobbi Brown in exchange for my honest review. What a unique and effective serum! I've been loving this for my makeup prep and feel like it does an amazing job at giving me a hydrated and flawless base to my base routine. I've been using this one for a few weeks now and use it at night before my moisturizer, and during the day before my primer. I love to partner it with the iconic face base and they make my skin look so much smoother and plump.

Gifted by Bobbi Brown. I've never really tried skincare from Bobbi before but I do find myself using it as a priming serum. It's been a while since I used a regular primer because I try to avoid multiple layers but I love how thin this is and actually noticed my makeup and skin looking better everyday.

I absolutely love this serum for skin prep before makeup! It leaves my skin feeling so hydrated and dewy! It smooths my skin like no other, i would highly recommend! I was gifted by Bobbi brown for an honest review

I have been using this Vitamin-Enriched Smoothing Serum and absolutely love it! The 2-in-1 serum helps my skin look smooth, glow, and hydrated for makeup. I am a big fan of the brand, especially this serum because I have already tried the first one. Gifted by Bobbi Brown

This milky serum is so so good! It goes on my skin nicely and absorbs easily. I love how hydrated my skin feels afterwords and love the way my skin looks after applying. I've noticed a difference in my skin now and would recommend this! Gifted by the brand.

This serum is fantastic! It glides on effortlessly and sinks into the skin in no time. I'm a big fan of the Niacinamide ingredient. It works wonderfully under makeup, and I am truly impressed. Just two pumps are all I need; it's incredibly lightweight and absorbs instantly without leaving any sticky feeling, leaving my skin feeling silky smooth. Each application makes my skin appear brighter, clearer, and more rejuvenated, while minimizing the appearance of my pores. The scent is heavenly and gives a spa-like experience without being overwhelming. Among all the serums available, I would highly recommend this one! Gifted by Bobbi Brown

This serum feels lightweight but super nourishing, like a mix between skincare and a primer. It glides on smoothly and makes my skin feel soft, plump, and prepped for makeup. The vitamin-rich formula gives a nice, healthy glow without feeling greasy. I love how it smooths out my texture and keeps my skin looking fresh all day. gifted by bobbibrown

I recently tried this over the holidays when they had the mini facebase snd serum sets. I ended up buying 2 sets for the serum. I had a couple places on my forehead from sun damage that were like fleshy raised skin patches. Id been dealing with them since summer. After using this serum those places left in about a week. I am sold and will be adding this serum with my holy grail face base. This stuff works! Bobbi brown face products keep my skin youthful during the day. Loveeee.
I noticed when I submitted my review on the product it said that I was incentivized. I was not. I left a glowing review because I love this product.

I purchased the Smoothing Serum for the first time one week ago and started using it exactly as directed. It is a game change and super easy to incorporate. I wash my face with the BB lathering tube soap (love the scent) followed by BB Tonic. Then I apply the serum followed by the enriched Face Base and Eye Moisturizers/Primers. I am not a person that brags about my skin, but it is glowing – it looks like I've just had an expensive facial. I am so pleased with the appearance of my face that I'm stepping out without foundation or tinted moisturizer. Bravo to Bobbi Brown for delivering a fabulous product at a fair price! I have invested in and used expensive high end (and medical grade) serums in the past and my skin responds to this serum more favorably. This is not a paid advertisement, but it should be. It was absolutely the missing step in my routine. This is just basic skin care at its finest. I highly recommend this product!
I really enjoy this product. It provided hydration to my dry skin, while smoothing and brightening it.

There was a real difference in my skin texture and sun spots after two weeks. It works well as a makeup base and has a lovely scent. I've never before used a product that worked so well and so quickly!

I got this as a sample in a combo box this summer. I put it on my face and immediately started feeling a burning sensation and washed it off. It also smells like lemon Pledge furniture polish/dusting spray. Great smell for my dresser, not so much for my face.

I was skeptical about the price of this serum. I had got a sample of it from sales lady at the store. Hands down! BEST serum I've ever used! I'll continue to use because this product sells itself! I highly recommend!

Im in love with this serum. I use this product under a serum foundation with no other moisturizer needed. Within a week I could see a big improvement in my skin. The biggest thing is how soft my skin feels and how much more even toned it is. I can't imagine putting my makeup on without applying this first. Also I love the light citrus scent.
I love this smoothing serum. I have to stop going crazy with it hahaha I just bought 4 of them and their beach perfume. It smells amazing

I love this serum, it's the next best thing to the Remedies 42 brightening serum that BB no longer offers. I'm a bit sad but this serum will do. It's great at evening out the skin as it moisturizes. It's one of the first products I use after washing my face and layering on other moisturizers. I have melasma and it has slowly lighten the skin but not as quickly as the Remedies 42 serum.
